display.title: Episode 147: The Lost Letter, Chapter 2
display.summary_short: After Tishrei, Uncle Yossi keeps the joy going and reads the new year 5745 as 'the year of Moshiach'; in the story, Reb Leibel loses his fortune, until the lost letter turns up.
display.summary_long: Right after the holidays, Uncle Yossi looks back on Elul and Tishrei, from the first shofar on Rosh Chodesh Elul to the last blast after Ne'ilah and the joy of Hakafos, and reminds listeners that a happy face is part of every Tzivos Hashem soldier's uniform. He explains that the letters of the new year 5745 can stand for 'This year will be the year of Melech HaMoshiach.' After the Hakochainik march and a sponsor message comes a recap of 'The Lost Letter.' The Shema guest is a six-year-old boy who carried an enormous drawing for the Shofar Gadol contest into the studio with his mother; Uncle Yossi says the judges are still deciding and every entrant will get a gift. Story time: one after another, messengers bring Reb Leibel bad news: a factory burns down, lightning sets his forest on fire, and over ten years his whole fortune disappears. His wife Miriam comforts him, but he wonders what he did wrong. Forced to sell his furniture for food, he has the movers carry out the cedar closet, and there on the floor lies the Baal Shem Tov's sealed letter. To be continued.
display.lesson: A blessing from a tzaddik opens a channel for Hashem's goodness, so never think you have no need of one; and a soldier of Hashem always wears a happy face.

date.note: 'Right after' Elul, Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur and Sukkos; the new year is 5745; the contest 'extended till after Sukkos' is still being judged. Episode 146 set the contest end as Tuesday 23 Oct 1984.
